title: The spread grows as the square root of 2Dt
spoken: Lambda x equals the square root of two D t.
explanation: The spread of a diffusing particle along one line after a time t: doubling the time multiplies it by the square root of two, not by two.
assumptions: Free diffusion along one line, starting from a known position.
A foundation lesson's statement in modern notation; not a transcription of the printed paper.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: The spread is fixed by the diffusion coefficient and the time.

notes.title: A square root
notes.explanation: Because of the root, multiplying the time by k multiplies the spread by the square root of k.

notes.title: Two, D and t
notes.explanation: The product under the root: twice the diffusion coefficient times the time.

notes.title: The spread
notes.explanation: Lambda x, the root-mean-square displacement along one line.

notes.title: Diffusion coefficient
notes.explanation: D, in square metres per second.

notes.title: Time
notes.explanation: t, the time since the particle was at its starting point.
